verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards service for AI vendor spend. Whether its software source is published under an open license is a fair question for a software-backed service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a source repository, an open-source license, or public code; the probes show only an llms.txt file and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
